{"notes": "Visit 4 (left 6:30). About 3.5 min left. Board: only the short start segment (x=2.5-6, y=10) is dark/connected. The back line (nose to tail) and the belly line are both pale. Neither visibly joins the start, so the fall would die after about 6 dominoes. Nose gap is still open (back line begins x=4, y=9.7; belly begins x=6, y=11). The tail fork is still cramped and unjoined. My visit-3 note said the belly was connected from the start; the picture doesn't show that, so I won't credit anyone for it.

Jack: Announced 'links are in at the nose' and started a dry run, but the picture doesn't back this up. Nothing is connected at the nose. Either the links are misplaced or the claim is overstated. He did ask Hana about the tail, which is good coordination. Launching a dry run with 3.5 min left risks toppling work. Still can't confirm he built the top line. Execution: unproven, and a reporting-accuracy concern. Verify next time.

Sofia: Stayed clear, delegated the bridge to Jack, asked to be called to check, and planned a dry run. Sensible, but she's relying on Jack's report without verifying, and the gap is still open. Strong communication, still no visible execution. Leadership credit is partial; she needs to check the picture, not the claim.

Omar: Not seen or heard this visit. Last seen announcing the upper tail fork. Unverified feed line, crowding at x=25.

Hana: Not seen or heard. Jack asked her about the tail crossing; no answer heard. Her dry run/join check is still unevidenced.

Next: check whether the start connects to either line, and whether the tail joins. Compare Jack's claim to the board."}
